what: Ben's Fusion check F1: a 100 × 20 × 10 bar cut through by a slot at x 30–40, an Extrude cut, leaving two bodies. The far piece, x 40–100, keeps Body 1: walking the bar's faces in the order they were made, the first wholly in one piece is the side x = 100, from the rectangle's second line (34a rule 1); the near piece, x 0–30, is Body 2.

recipe.do: Start a new part and delete its ready-made box (feature-1) from the timeline, as the L bracket's make does, so the counter goes on from 2.
Create Sketch on the top plane XY.
Rectangle tool: click (0, 0), then (100, 20) (points 3, 4, 6, 8; lines 5, 7, 9, 10: line 5 the side y = 0, line 7, the second, the side x = 100).
Extrude the sketch 10 (z 0 to 10): Body 1, the bar.
Create Sketch on the top plane XY.

Rectangle tool: click (30, −5), then (40, 25): the slot, past both of the bar's long sides (points and lines 13 to 20; seen along Z the bar offers its corners and its edges' middles (50, 0), (50, 20), (0, 10), (100, 10), none here).
Extrude the sketch 10 (z 0 to 10) as a Cut; objects to cut: Body 1 (the visible body it overlaps, 39a).
